templates.name: Lanternfield
templates.bestFor: Many connected topics where the links matter: systems, ecosystems, who-does-what, product maps.
templates.dataShape: { clusters:[{id,label,color}], nodes:[{id,cluster,title,summary}], links:[{source,target,label}], tours? }
templates.sample: How a city works: 56 systems and 94 links (illustrative)

templates.name: Tidepool
templates.bestFor: Budgets, allocations and trade-offs, where moving one amount changes the others.
templates.dataShape: { unit, period, conserve, step, items:[{id,label,value,min?,max?,locked?,note?}] }
templates.sample: A fortnight's pay in FJD (example figures)

templates.name: Strata
templates.bestFor: Anything with levels: catalogues, curricula, spending categories, organisations.
mechanics: X-ray strip previews what is inside
Pull a layer out to drill in
templates.dataShape: { unit, unitSingular, source, root:{label,note,children:[…]} }
templates.sample: FijiLearn catalogue: 9 subjects, 40 courses, 109 chapters (real data, 11 Nov 2026)

templates.name: Riverline
templates.bestFor: Histories, project timelines and logs, where it matters when things bunch together.
mechanics: Reading strip of what is in view
templates.dataShape: { view?, lanes:[{id,label}], eras:[{start,end,label}], events:[{date,when?,title,summary,lane,weight?}] }
templates.sample: Fiji through time: 23 dated events from c. 1000 BCE to 2022

templates.name: Switchback
templates.bestFor: Histories, case studies and project stories meant to be read in order.
mechanics: Alternating cards that collapse to one column
templates.dataShape: { categories|lanes:[{id,label}], eras?, events:[{date|start, end?, when?, title, summary?, category|lane, status?, progress?, depends?, milestone?}] } (shared by every timeline view; Riverline data works too)
templates.sample: Fiji through time: dated events plus spans

templates.name: Swimlane
templates.bestFor: Several threads happening side by side: departments, product lines, family branches, themes in history.
mechanics: Navigator strip with a draggable window
Detail panel with previous and next
templates.dataShape: { categories|lanes:[{id,label}], eras?, events:[{date|start, end?, when?, title, summary?, category|lane, status?, progress?, depends?, milestone?}] } (shared by every timeline view; Riverline data works too)
templates.sample: Fiji through time: dated events plus spans

templates.name: Roadmap
templates.bestFor: Project plans, launch schedules and anything with tasks that depend on each other.
mechanics: Drag to slip a task; dependants follow
templates.dataShape: { categories|lanes:[{id,label}], eras?, events:[{date|start, end?, when?, title, summary?, category|lane, status?, progress?, depends?, milestone?}] } (shared by every timeline view; Riverline data works too)
templates.sample: Adding a template to an app (example plan)

templates.name: Waypath
templates.bestFor: Step-by-step processes, learning paths, onboarding and journeys, with or without dates.
templates.dataShape: { categories|lanes:[{id,label}], eras?, events:[{date|start, end?, when?, title, summary?, category|lane, status?, progress?, depends?, milestone?}] } (shared by every timeline view; Riverline data works too)
templates.sample: How an app adopts a template (real process)

templates.name: Rankrace
templates.bestFor: Rankings that change over time: top products, busiest months, leading regions, league tables.
mechanics: Leader and biggest climber in words
templates.dataShape: { prefix?, suffix?, top?, items:[{id,label,color?}], frames:[{label, values:{id:number}}] }
templates.sample: Market stall sales by product (example figures)

templates.name: Peoplegrid
templates.bestFor: Showing a share as countable things: people, households, chapters, votes, out of 100.
mechanics: Regroups between grid, blocks and bars
templates.dataShape: { unit, unitPlural?, groups:[{id,label,color?,count}] }
templates.sample: FijiLearn chapters by subject (real data)

templates.name: Guessline
templates.bestFor: Surprising trends: growth, savings, prices, anything where intuition is usually wrong.
mechanics: Draw the rest of the line
templates.dataShape: { question, prefix?, suffix?, known:index, points:[{x, y}], source? }
templates.sample: Savings growth over 10 years (calculated)

templates.name: Flowbank
templates.bestFor: Money, people or energy moving from sources to destinations: budgets, funding, migration, supply chains.
templates.dataShape: { prefix?, nodes:[{id,label,color?}], links:[{source,target,value}] }
templates.sample: Where a fortnight’s pay goes (example figures)

templates.name: Ledger
templates.bestFor: Anything people want to look up or compare item by item: price lists, directories, catalogues, results.
templates.dataShape: { columns:[{id,label,type:text|number|bar|heat|spark|tag}], rows:[{…, detail?}], tags?:[{id,label,color?}] }
templates.sample: Every FijiLearn course (real data)

templates.name: Storyscroll
templates.bestFor: Explaining a finding step by step: reports, explainers, annual reviews, results pages.
templates.dataShape: { items:[{id,label,value,group?}], groups?, steps:[{title?, text, highlight?:[ids], sort?:value|label|none, only?:[ids]}] }
templates.sample: The FijiLearn catalogue in five steps (real data)

templates.name: Tilemap
templates.bestFor: Results by province, district, island or region, where real map shapes would make small places impossible to see.
mechanics: Colour by group or by value
Tap a tile for detail and its neighbours in the group
templates.dataShape: { groups?:[{id,label,color?}], tiles:[{id,label,short?,row,col,group?,value?,note?}], valueLabel?, prefix?, suffix? }
templates.sample: Provinces of Fiji by division (real)

templates.name: Mosaic
templates.bestFor: Budgets, portfolios, catalogues and anything where the parts of the parts matter.
mechanics: Share of the whole in words
templates.dataShape: { unit?, unitSingular?, root:{label, children:[{label,value?,note?,children?}]} }
templates.sample: FijiLearn subjects and courses (real data)

templates.name: Duel
templates.bestFor: Product or plan comparisons, before and after, this year versus last, one place against another.
templates.dataShape: { items:[{id,label,values:{metricId:number}}], metrics:[{id,label,prefix?,suffix?,better?:higher|lower}], a?, b? }
templates.sample: FijiLearn subjects compared (real data)

templates.name: Almanac
templates.bestFor: Habits, attendance, activity logs, sales by day: anything that happens (or doesn’t) day by day.
mechanics: Active days and totals in words
templates.dataShape: { days:{ 'YYYY-MM-DD': number }, label?, unit?, goal?, from?, to? }
templates.sample: Daily study minutes (example figures)

templates.name: Goalmeter
templates.bestFor: Fundraising, savings goals, project targets, community campaigns.
mechanics: Milestones reached or still to go
Projected finish date at the current pace
templates.dataShape: { goal, prefix?, suffix?, label?, milestones?:[{at,label}], entries:[{date:'YYYY-MM-DD', amount, note?}] }
templates.sample: Village water tank fund (example figures)

templates.name: Dayclock
templates.bestFor: Daily routines, shift patterns, opening hours, how a service is used across the day.
mechanics: Tap a slice for times and share
Time per activity in the legend
templates.dataShape: { activities:[{id,label,color?}], days:[{id,label,blocks:[{activity,from:'HH:MM',to:'HH:MM',note?}]}] }
templates.sample: A school day, a market day and a Sunday (example)

templates.name: Settlement Flow
templates.bestFor: Sandbox clearance slides and live capital-flow reports: a five-stage settlement path with the headline numbers.
templates.sample: Example values from the Infographics Fiji spec

templates.sample: Example values from the Infographics Fiji spec
